permitted_at_checkpoint: Constraining the optimal settings to the boundary of the explored design space (radius 1.414).

Running physical confirmation samples at the constrained optimum to empirically establish true capability.

allowed_alternatives: Relying entirely on physical confirmation run data rather than theoretical model predictions to claim attainment of the 55 N requirement.

reviews.rationale: The report brilliantly navigates standard pitfalls in response surface methodology. It correctly recognizes that the mathematical optimum requires unjustified extrapolation and successfully constrains the optimization to the explored region. Furthermore, it identifies that a significant lack-of-fit test driven by an extremely small pure error indicates the quadratic model is an approximation, not a perfect description. By proceeding to a confirmation run and observing the expected model over-prediction, the analysis successfully anchors its final capability claims in empirical reality rather than flawed theory.
